body: chalk numbers run across the fire extinguisher and camera. the count skips one place, then resumes in a different hand.
title: missing count beside the fire extinguisher
gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

title: First trap held a torn field tag
body: Diary line at the first trap: a torn pasture-test tag was caught beneath the spring. Its number belongs to a drum the return ledger calls sealed.
rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.
